item.text:
Refactored [BalancedParentheses.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/042_balanced_parentheses/BalancedParentheses.java:1) again to make the bracket rules data-driven instead of hardcoded across multiple methods. The validator now uses immutable `Map`/`Set` constants as the single source of truth, iterates with `charAt` instead of allocating `toCharArray()`, and lets `main` accept an optional input argument while preserving the default sample.

I also simplified [BalancedParenthesesTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/042_balanced_parentheses/BalancedParenthesesTest.java:1) into parameterized tests. That reduced duplication and expanded coverage to 8 cases, including empty input, text with no brackets, extra closing brackets, and wrong-order closers.

Verified with:
```sh
mkdir -p build/test-classes && javac -cp lib/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.10.2.jar -d build/test-classes BalancedParentheses.java BalancedParenthesesTest.java && java -jar lib/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.10.2.jar execute --class-path build/test-classes --scan-class-path
```
All 8 tests passed.
